children: HeartSciences appointed Jaime Leverton as CEO of Fortitude and highlighted leadership changes as the companies advance their proposed merger.
Fortitude named Jaime Leverton CEO effective Sept 21, 2026; Andrea Childs will transition to COO.
Leverton is expected to serve as CEO and join HeartSciences' board upon closing of the proposed merger.
Fortitude reported mining 72,696 ZEC and $20.9M revenue in Q2; owns >60 MW across seven sites.
Merger with HeartSciences is expected to close in Q4 2026, subject to customary conditions and shareholder approval.
